rationale: The selected-geometry strategy did not preserve the strong starting model. A narrowly scoped B-learning-rate test remains relevant because the completed training changed the deployed blend and reduced accuracy. The isolated test will measure raw and clamped blend coefficients; it does not assume saturation or establish the optimizer as the cause.
prior_control_comparison_limit: The previous selected_geometry run has the same nominal learning rates as equal_span_lr, but lacks the new raw-gate diagnostics and the separate optimizer-group representation. Treat it as a recorded empirical reference until actual common initial behavior and the isolated runtime are verified.
changed_normal_training_variable: B span-mixer learning rate 1e-5 to 1e-6 only
